function: Excluded for above_phy: the learned Exp3 bandit only selects which clients join each over-the-air FL round (client scheduling, p. 7); the power scaling is a fixed rule, not learned (p. 6).
notes: Exclusion code above_phy (4). The work proposes DCSE, a dynamic client selection strategy for over-the-air federated learning with volatile, energy-limited clients. p. 1: "we introduce a dynamic client selection strategy termed DCSE, based on Exp3 with multiple plays and energy constraints". p. 7: "the clients can be considered as base arms, while the selected set At is commonly referred to as a super arm", so the only learned decision is which clients are scheduled in each round, which is scheduling and access control above the physical layer. The physical-layer quantity, the power scaling factor, is not learned: p. 6: "we set σt as a hyperparameter" (Eq. 17, a closed form from an SNR threshold). The FL model itself passes no_learning, since the work is over-the-air FL, but the learning contribution does not act on aggregation over the air, beams or channel. Only one code is given. For the reviewer, the channel is also a scalar gain hk,t per client (p. 5, Eq. 5) with Rayleigh fading (p. 10), so system could apply too, but above_phy is the first code in the order.
